title: Target transition above a thickening
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring and $q\in\mathbf Z$. Let $i:T_1\to T_2$ be a closed immersion of schemes surjective on points [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $e_2:Y_2\to T_2$, $h_2:Y_2\to X$, $a:Y_1\to Y_2$, $e_1:Y_1\to T_1$, and $h_1:Y_1\to X$ satisfy $h_2a=h_1$, with the square $e_2a=i e_1$ cartesian. For any etale sheaf $F$ of $\Lambda$-modules on $T_2$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], the canonical transition between the degree-$q$ targets of [sbc-def-base-change-map], $R^qh_{2,*}e_2^{-1}F\to R^qh_{1,*}e_1^{-1}i^{-1}F$, is an isomorphism.

source.place: Proof, condition (1): thickenings; transition compatibility made explicit

proof.text: Give i its Surjective instance from hi. Use MorphismProperty.of_isPullback on sq.flip to obtain both IsClosedImmersion a and Surjective a. Apply Etale.isEquivalence_upperStar_of_thickening to a.

The additive sheaf equivalence induces an equivalence on the unbounded derived categories by Functor.isEquivalence_mapDerivedCategory. Its restriction D+(a*) is full and faithful: cancel the full faithful inclusions using mapDerivedCategoryPlusCompatibility, Full.of_comp_faithful_iso and Faithful.of_comp_iso. Therefore the unit of D+(a*) adjoint to R+(a*) is invertible by Adjunction.unit_isIso_of_L_fully_faithful.

Substitute h1 = a followed by h2. The private proved helper transition_eq_unit identifies the defining mate with Rh2 applied to the unit for a followed by the right-adjoint composition comparison. Apply the inverse hom-set equivalence of the h1 adjunction to both sides. conjugateEquiv_counit rewrites the conjugate comparison; naturality of the left comparison moves Rh2(unit_a) past it. Expand the composite counit by Adjunction.comp_counit_app, use naturality of the h2 counit, then the left triangle identity for a. Thus the transition is a composite of isomorphisms.

Expand baseChangeTargetTransition. The lowerStarPlusTransition is an isomorphism by the preceding calculation. The two pullback composition comparisons, equality transport from sq.w and degree-zero single-functor comparison are isomorphisms. Direct image and degree-q homology preserve these isomorphisms, giving the conclusion for every integer q.
